title: WaveformProcessingFailed
description: Published by Waveform on routing key waveform.failed when it gives up on a song's waveform: immediately for a permanent problem (e.g. undecodable audio), or after the 3rd attempt for a transient one. The SongUploaded message is also moved to waveform.song-uploaded.dlq. Catalogue sets waveform_status = FAILED.

error_code.description: Machine-readable reason, e.g. INVALID_EVENT, AUDIO_NOT_FOUND, AUDIO_TOO_LARGE, AUDIO_UNDECODABLE, AUDIO_EMPTY, DECODE_TIMEOUT, PROCESSING_ERROR.

message.description: Human-readable detail for logs and the UI.

attempts.description: How many times processing was attempted before giving up.
